notes.title: Playtest #3
notes.content:
[h3]Another playtest??!! Yes! and we've got some juicy new stuff![/h3][p]Our third Steam playtest will be live from [b]16:00 CEST[/b] [b]28/08 until 31/08/2025![/b] 🗓️[/p][p][/p][p][b]Notable changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]A [b]Tutorial [/b]to guide new recruits[/p][/*][*][p][b]Grenades [/b]are in! And if the standard boom isn’t enough, try out some explosive upgrades[/p][/*][*][p]A brand-new [b]HUB[/b] area[/p][/*][*][p]The first taste of [b]Skill Tree[/b] progression (limited for now, but a glimpse of what’s coming!)[/p][/*][/list][p]For the Full changelist please check our discord 
[url="https://discord.gg/xzNvYEp2ms"]https://discord.gg/xzNvYEp2ms[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Please note that this is a playtest, while we did our best to deliver a very polished and fun build there is still some missing features and there will be bugs 🐞.[/p][p][/p][p]If you encounter a bug, please report it in: ⁠🐞[url="steam://openurl_external/https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.com%2Fchannels%2F1011227918921367553%2F1378745978290569361"]Discord | Bugs[/url] or [url="steam://openurl/https://steamcommunity.com/app/3585460/discussions/?snr=___"]Galactic Vault | Discussions[/url][/p][p]If you have suggestions or ideas, let us know in: ⁠💡[url="steam://openurl_external/https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.com%2Fchannels%2F1011227918921367553%2F1378746948936400986"]Discord | Suggestions[/url] or [url="steam://openurl/https://steamcommunity.com/app/3585460/discussions/?snr=___"]Galactic Vault | Discussions[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Scrap those weekend plans and play some Galactic Vault ːsteamhappyː[/p]
